prompt: Translate a fully qualified class name into the file paths javac uses for it. Complete the four ClassFilePathMapper methods, then run the tests.
explanation: The package part of a name maps one-to-one onto directories, so replace('.', '/') plus the right extension is the whole path rule. Splitting a name into package and simple name is a lastIndexOf('.') problem: everything before the last dot is the package, everything after it is the class. When there is no dot, lastIndexOf returns -1, which conveniently makes substring(lastDot + 1) return the whole name for a default-package class.
hints: replace('.', '/') converts the dotted name to a directory path in one call.
Use lastIndexOf('.') to split package from simple name -- an earlier dot belongs to the package.
lastIndexOf returns -1 when there is no dot; substring(-1 + 1) is substring(0), which is exactly what a default-package name needs.
